questions.scenario_zh: 周五傍晚刚下班，最想做的是？
questions.scenario_en: It's Friday at 6pm, you just finished work — what do you most want to do?
options_zh: 按计划完成今晚的锻炼和恢复流程，然后准时上床睡觉
叫上一大群朋友，去最热闹的地方玩到尽兴
回家陪家人或最熟的几个人，安安静静吃顿饭
options_en: Complete tonight's workout and recovery routine as planned, then get to bed on time
Round up a big group of friends and hit the liveliest place in town
Go home to family or your closest few people and share a quiet dinner

questions.scenario_zh: 最好的朋友凌晨两点哭着打电话来，说刚被分手。你的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your closest friend calls you at 2am, crying — they just got dumped. What's your first move?
options_zh: 什么都不多问，安静听完，告诉他：我一直都在
先骂那个伤害他的人一顿，然后马上打车过去陪他
帮他把事情理清楚，冷静给出接下来该怎么办的建议
options_en: Ask nothing, just listen quietly to the end, then tell them: I'm here, always
Curse out whoever hurt them first, then grab a cab and go be with them right now
Help them sort out what happened and calmly lay out what to do next

questions.scenario_zh: 会议上你的方案被领导当众说"逻辑不通"，你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: In a meeting, your boss publicly says your proposal 'doesn't make logical sense.' Your reaction?
options_zh: 当场沉住气不争辩，之后拿出一版无可挑剔的成果让他收回这句话
当场回应，条理清晰、寸步不让地把方案捍卫到底
耸耸肩不往心里去，该改就改，心情完全不受影响
options_en: Hold steady and say nothing — then come back with work so flawless he has to take it back
Respond on the spot: defend the proposal point by point without giving an inch
Shrug it off completely — fix what needs fixing, mood untouched

questions.scenario_zh: 你突然收到一笔 5 万块的意外奖金，第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: An unexpected bonus drops into your account. What's your gut move?
options_zh: 投进长期规划里——投资自己、布局未来，钱要为目标服务
给家人买点东西，剩下的存起来，日子照旧
请兄弟们痛快庆祝一场，钱就是拿来制造快乐的
options_en: Put it into the long game — invest in yourself and your future plans; money serves the goal
Buy something for family, save the rest, and carry on exactly as before
Throw a proper celebration for your crew — money exists to make joy

questions.scenario_zh: 第一次约会，你倾向于怎么安排？
questions.scenario_en: First date — how do you want to set it up?
options_zh: 提前把每个环节都安排到位，让对方看到最好状态的你
带对方去好玩的地方，让气氛自己热起来，笑声不断
找家简单熟悉的小馆子，自然、舒服、聊得来最重要
options_en: Plan every detail in advance so they see you at your absolute best
Take them somewhere fun and let the vibe build itself — nonstop laughter
A simple familiar little place — natural, comfortable, good conversation above all

questions.scenario_zh: 室友把你冰箱里准备明天招待客人的食材提前吃掉了。你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your roommate ate the food you were saving in the fridge for tomorrow's guests. Your reaction?
options_zh: 当场发火说清楚：这不行，今晚就得补回来
无所谓，笑着损他两句，改点外卖照样招待
平静地讲清楚下次的规矩，然后自己想办法补救
options_en: Call it out on the spot: not okay — replace it tonight
No big deal — roast them a little, order delivery, the guests will be fine
Calmly set the rule for next time, then quietly sort out a fix yourself

questions.scenario_zh: 派对上你被介绍给一个看起来很有趣的陌生人，你的开场是？
questions.scenario_en: At a party, you get introduced to someone who looks interesting. Your opener?
options_zh: 几句话就跟对方玩到一起，像认识了很多年的老友
大方得体地聊，自信展示自己，也把对方的故事聊出来
礼貌微笑，话不多，更多时候在安静地听
options_en: Within a few sentences you're joking around like friends of many years
Chat with easy confidence — present yourself well and draw out their story too
Smile politely, say little, mostly just listen

questions.scenario_zh: 最好的朋友突然出大事，半夜来找你帮忙。你的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your best friend hits a sudden crisis and shows up at your door at midnight. First move?
options_zh: 先问清楚是谁的事——要出头我第一个上，天塌下来我先扛
让他先冷静，把事实一条条理清楚，当场列出行动计划
先把人安顿好：吃的、热水、铺好的床，其他明天再说
options_en: First find out who did this — if someone needs to step up, I'm first in line
Calm them down, walk through the facts one by one, and draw up an action plan on the spot
Settle them in first — food, something warm, a made-up bed; the rest can wait until morning

questions.scenario_zh: 你最讨厌的人意外升职了。你心里的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Someone you can't stand just got promoted. Your first internal reaction?
options_zh: 燃起一股狠劲：好，那我就做得更好，让所有人都看见
跟我没关系，我的目标在更远的地方，不为这种事分心
找朋友吐槽一顿，笑一笑，然后该干嘛干嘛
options_en: A fire lights up: fine — I'll just do better, and make sure everyone sees it
Irrelevant to me — my goals are much further away; not worth the distraction
Vent to friends, have a laugh about it, then back to living

questions.scenario_zh: 想象十年后的自己，你最希望的画面是？
questions.scenario_en: Picture yourself ten years from now — what's the version you most hope for?
options_zh: 站在行业之巅，名字被所有人记住，还在向新的领域扩张
和家人在安静的地方生活，作息规律，守着自然和自己爱的一切
带着一帮老兄弟把日子过成节日，走到哪儿都是笑声
options_en: At the very top of the field — a name everyone knows, still expanding into new territory
A quiet life with family and steady routines, close to nature and everything you truly love
Turning life into one long festival with the same old crew — laughter wherever you go

questions.scenario_zh: 凌晨三点你毫无征兆地醒了，再也睡不着。你最可能做什么？
questions.scenario_en: It's 3am and you're suddenly wide awake. Most likely move?
options_zh: 启动自己的一套入睡流程重新入睡——睡眠神圣不可侵犯
拿起手机看看消息，跟还没睡的朋友聊上两句
干脆想想事情——最近的目标、下一步的打算，想通了再睡
options_en: Run your wind-down routine and get back to sleep — sleep is sacred
Check your phone and chat a bit with whichever friends are still up
Might as well think — recent goals, next moves; sleep comes once it's sorted

questions.scenario_zh: 部门年会需要有人上台表演节目，大家的目光突然都投向你。你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: The office party needs someone to perform on stage, and suddenly every head turns to you. Your reaction?
options_zh: 来！我早就等着这一刻——聚光灯打过来，上台就是我的主场
使劲推辞，实在躲不掉就红着脸快速来一个，马上把话筒交出去
行，但一个人上多没意思——把兄弟们全拉上台，变成集体节目一起闹
options_en: Yes! I've been waiting for this — hit the lights, that stage is my home turf
Deflect hard; if truly cornered, do something quick while blushing and hand the mic right back
Fine — but solo is boring: drag the whole crew up and turn it into a group act
